title: CROSS+WALKRI Runbook Schema (Operator Cohort)
description: The operational procedures the round operates under, fully populated. Disambiguation from Round Config: the Round Config specifies what is to be done (parameters, rules, configurations); the Runbook specifies how those parameters are operationally executed across the CLEAR lifecycle. Supersedes v0.1.0 (skeleton).

round_config_reference.description: The Round Config version this runbook operationalizes. The runbook executes the configuration; the configuration defines the rules.

commit.description: Funder publishes the obligation architecture. All three artifacts (round-config, runbook, applicant-facing-publication) are produced and published. Publication is immutable from this point; any modification requires a new round identifier.

list.description: Intake against the published specification. Applications collected; pre-conditions checked; incomplete applications handled per published rules.

evaluate.description: Assessment against the committed criteria. Determination body engages applications; scoring procedure applied; findings generated and recorded.

iteration_handling_procedure.description: Applies at progress verification gates (Developmental in character). Does not apply at completion verification gates (Summative in character).

attest.description: Evidence submitted at completion. Attestation Corpus queried; evidence strength validated against round's configured tier; completion findings generated.

register.description: Outcomes registered into the institutional record. Determinations published; Attestation Corpus updated; Inter-cycle Reflection Stage inputs collected; Obligation Fulfillment Record updated for each applicant.

clear_stages.x-cross-walkri-source-section: Primitives Foundation v0.1.6 Foundational Structural Anchors
clear_stages.description: The five stages of the round lifecycle as procedurally specified.

determination_body_reference.description: Reference to the determination body specified in the round-config.

scoring_procedure.description: Step-by-step scoring methodology including evidence weight, criterion ordering, and aggregation rules.

tie_break_procedure.description: How tied scores are resolved (e.g., earlier application timestamp, public benefit mechanism priority, randomized selection from tied set).

appeals_procedure.description: How within-determination-body appeals are handled before findings are finalized.

inter_cycle_reflection_procedures.x-cross-walkri-primitive: Inter-cycle Reflection Stage (Program Learning Architecture configuration, Layer 7)
inter_cycle_reflection_procedures.x-cross-walkri-source-section: Primitives Foundation v0.2.0 Layer 7 (Program Learning Architecture configuration)

beneficiary_validation_procedures.description: Required when round-config public_benefit_mechanism.mechanism_type is condition_change or access_provision. Operational procedures for the entry-stage validation.

affected_population_verification_procedu.x-cross-walkri-primitive: Affected Population Verification Gate (Evidence Strength configuration, Layer 4)
affected_population_verification_procedu.x-cross-walkri-source-section: Primitives Foundation v0.2.0 Layer 4 (Evidence Strength configuration)
affected_population_verification_procedu.description: Required when round-config public_benefit_mechanism.mechanism_type is condition_change or access_provision. Operational procedures for the completion-stage verification. Renamed from Beneficiary Accountability Gate at Primitives Foundation v0.1.7.

surfacing_procedure.description: How adverse signals are collected from applicants at entry gate and identified by reviewers during evaluation.

review_procedure.description: How surfaced signals are reviewed and how the determination body's response is documented.

log_maintenance_procedure.description: Standing log update procedure; per-signal entries; publication cadence.

suppression_prevention_procedure.description: Operational controls preventing reviewer suppression of adverse signals encountered during evaluation.

adverse_signal_engagement_procedures.x-cross-walkri-primitive: Adverse Signal Engagement Principle Core Standard

query_construction_procedure.description: How queries are constructed per applicant against the Attestation Corpus sources specified in the round-config.

query_execution_procedure.description: Operational details of query execution against each source, including API access patterns and rate-limit handling.

snapshot_recording_procedure.description: How query results are recorded as Attestation Corpus snapshots with timestamps.

redress_procedures.description: Operational procedures for grantee redress at completion verification gates. Per CROSS Part XI funder obligations.

waiver_procedure.description: Procedure for Tier 2 qualified waivers including authority approval flow and documentation requirements.

attestation_integrity_check_procedure.description: Procedure for verifying that any party signing an attestation confirming applicant evidence is not Tier 1 conflicted with that applicant.

data_quality_assurance_procedures.x-cross-walkri-source-section: WALKRI Part V; Primitives Foundation v0.1.6 Layer 5

format_neutrality_operational_procedure.x-cross-walkri-source-section: Primitives Foundation v0.1.6 Layer 1; Evolution Rules Commitment 5
format_neutrality_operational_procedure.description: How the operator verifies that infrastructure presented by applicants meets content requirements without imposing format prescriptions beyond those named as primitive requirements in the round-config.

em_dash_discipline.const: No em dash (U+2014) appears in any operator-published artifact; grep-verify before publication.

frame_language_discipline.description: Operator-published artifacts are grep-checked against the Frame 1 watchlist; each hit receives a Part I admissibility check; leaks are replaced per the Frame Language Replacement Table.
